name: MonarchVirtualMessageList
title: VirtualMessageList
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.LazyColumn with reverseLayout = true and LazyListState (requestScrollToItem to follow new messages); MonarchLoadMore for older history, MonarchLoadingState, MonarchButton for the jump button, androidx.compose.material3.HorizontalDivider in separators; android.icu.text.DateFormat for day labels
summary: A conversation's messages pinned to the bottom: only the rows on screen are composed, with day separators, a New messages divider, older history loaded at the top and a button that jumps to the latest message.
whenToUse: For the message area of a chat, a support conversation or a thread panel, with each row drawn by MonarchMessageRow and the composer under the list.
whenNotToUse: For a short discussion shown in place next to a document or field, use MonarchCommentThread. For a list of conversations, use MonarchInboxRow in a LazyColumn. For a page-by-page list read from the top, use MonarchCursorList.
api: @Composable fun <T> MonarchVirtualMessageList(items: List<T>, key: (item: T) -> Any, time: (item: T) -> Long, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, state: LazyListState = rememberLazyListState(), authorId: (item: T) -> String? = { null }, firstUnreadKey: Any? = null, hasOlder: Boolean = false, loadingOlder: Boolean = false, olderFailed: Boolean = false, loading: Boolean = false, stickToBottom: Boolean = true, jumpToLatest: Boolean = true, scrollToKey: Any? = null, loadOlderThreshold: Int = 5, groupWindowMillis: Long = 300_000L, now: Long? = null, locale: Locale? = null, timeZone: String? = null, labels: MonarchVirtualMessageListLabels = MonarchVirtualMessageListLabels(), onLoadOlder: (() -> Unit)? = null, onRetryOlder: (() -> Unit)? = null, onAtBottomChange: ((Boolean) -> Unit)? = null, jumpIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, header: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, footer: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, status: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, empty: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, error: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, row: @Composable LazyItemScope.(item: T, context: MonarchVirtualMessageListContext<T>) -> Unit)
class MonarchVirtualMessageListContext<out T>(grouped: Boolean, index: Int, previous: T?)

class MonarchVirtualMessageListLabels(label: String? = null, newMessages: String? = null, today: String? = null, yesterday: String? = null, jumpToLatest: String? = null, unseen: ((count: Int) -> String)? = null, arrived: ((count: Int) -> String)? = null, loadOlder: String? = null, loadingOlder: String? = null, olderFailed: String? = null, retryOlder: String? = null, loading: String? = null)

options.name: items
options.description: The loaded messages, oldest first. Prepend older pages; append new messages.

options.name: key
options.description: A stable, unique key per message, as for LazyColumn; also the anchor for the unread divider and scrollToKey.

options.name: time
options.description: When a message was sent, in epoch milliseconds (UTC), for day separators and grouping.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the list. Give it a bounded height.

options.name: state
options.description: The scroll state. Index 0 is the bottom row.

options.name: authorId
options.description: The author of a message, for grouping consecutive messages. null never groups.

options.name: firstUnreadKey
options.description: The key of the first unread message: a New messages divider goes above it.

options.name: hasOlder
options.description: There is older history: a Load older messages row at the top, and onLoadOlder near the top.

options.name: loadingOlder
options.description: Older history is loading: the top row shows progress.

options.name: olderFailed
options.description: Loading older history failed: the top row says so and offers Retry.

options.name: loading
options.description: The first load: a MonarchLoadingState placeholder while there are no items.

options.name: stickToBottom
options.description: Follows new messages while the reader is at the bottom.

options.name: jumpToLatest
options.description: Shows the jump button while the reader is scrolled up; it counts messages that arrived.

options.name: scrollToKey
options.description: Scrolls to this message once it is loaded, for example after opening a link to it.

options.name: loadOlderThreshold
options.description: onLoadOlder is called when the top row is this many rows away.

options.name: groupWindowMillis
options.description: Consecutive messages by one author within this time are grouped (five minutes).

options.name: now
options.description: The current time for Today and Yesterday. null reads the clock.

options.name: locale
options.description: The locale of the day labels. null uses the configuration's.

options.name: timeZone
options.description: The time zone in which days start. An IANA id such as Europe/Berlin; null, or an id the device does not know, is the device's zone.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for every built-in string.

options.name: onLoadOlder
options.description: Loads the previous page. Called near the top and by the Load older messages button.

options.name: onRetryOlder
options.description: Retries a failed page. null calls onLoadOlder.

options.name: onAtBottomChange
options.description: Called with true or false when the reader reaches or leaves the bottom, and once at the start.

options.name: jumpIcon
options.description: The jump button's icon, a downward arrow MonarchIcon with a null description. Text only without it.

options.name: header
options.description: Above the first message once all history is loaded, such as the start of the conversation.

options.name: footer
options.description: Below the last message, such as a read receipt.

options.name: status
options.description: Under the list in a polite live region, such as a MonarchTypingIndicator.

options.name: empty
options.description: Shown with no messages and no older history. header by default.

options.name: error
options.description: Shown instead of the list when the first load failed, such as a MonarchErrorState.

options.name: row
options.description: Draws one message, usually a MonarchMessageRow with grouped = context.grouped.

states.name: at the bottom
states.description: The newest message is in view; new messages scroll into view and are announced.

states.name: scrolled up
states.description: A secondary small button at the bottom says Jump to latest, or N new messages once messages arrived; it scrolls to the bottom (instantly when animations are off).

states.name: older available
states.description: The top row is a Load older messages button; onLoadOlder is also called when the top comes near.

states.name: loading older
states.description: The top row shows Loading older messages… with progress.

states.name: older failed
states.description: The top row says Couldn't load older messages. with Retry.

states.name: first load
states.description: A MonarchLoadingState placeholder named Loading messages.

states.name: empty
states.description: The empty slot, or the header.

states.name: error
states.description: The error slot instead of the list.

appearance: The list has no fill of its own. Day separators are muted captions between subtle border lines; the New messages divider uses the strong accent text and accent border roles; the rows, Load more and the jump button keep their own roles. The same roles adapt to dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web measures and positions rows itself (a virtualised scroller with estimated heights, overscan and server-rendered rows); Android uses LazyColumn with reverseLayout, which already composes only the visible rows and keeps the view still when older pages are prepended, so estimatedItemHeight, overscan and initialRenderCount have no equivalent. The web's imperative handle (scrollToBottom, scrollToItem) is replaced by the hoisted LazyListState and scrollToKey. The web's items implement an interface with id, time and authorId; Android takes key, time and authorId selectors so app models need not implement a Monarch type. Thresholds are in rows (loadOlderThreshold), not pixels. highlightedId is not taken: the row slot gets the item and can pass highlighted to MonarchMessageRow. The New messages divider uses the accent tone, as on the web. iOS has no entry for this id yet.
accessibility: The list is named Messages for TalkBack.
Day separators and the New messages divider are headings, so TalkBack can jump between days.
Messages that arrive are announced as N new messages through a polite live region that is always present; rows themselves are not live, so scrolling stays quiet.
The status slot is in a polite live region, so a typing indicator is announced.
The jump button and Load older messages are buttons with a 48dp touch target; the jump button's text says how many messages arrived, not only an icon.
The jump scroll is instant when the user has removed animations.
edgeCases: A message whose key does not change keeps its place; replacing the whole list (a different conversation) is not announced as arrivals.
Grouping needs a known author; it never crosses a day or the New messages divider.
A message timed before the previous one is not grouped with it.
onLoadOlder is not called while loadingOlder or olderFailed is true; after a page arrives it is called again only if the top is still near.
Do not put the list in a vertically scrolling parent.

examples.title: 2,000-message history
examples.template:
Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(MonarchTheme.spacing.space2)) {
    Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(MonarchTheme.spacing.space2)) {
        MonarchButton(
            text = {{receive}},
            onClick = { messages = messages + message(messages.size + {{history.from}}) },
            variant = MonarchButtonVariant.Secondary,
            size = MonarchButtonSize.Sm,
        )
        MonarchButton(
            text = {{goTo.label}},
            onClick = { scrollTo = {{goTo.id}} },
            variant = MonarchButtonVariant.Ghost,
            size = MonarchButtonSize.Sm,
        )
    }
    MonarchVirtualMessageList(
        items = messages,
        key = { it.id },
        time = { it.time },
        modifier = Modifier.height(560.dp),
        authorId = { it.author },
        firstUnreadKey = {{firstUnreadId}},
        hasOlder = true,
        scrollToKey = scrollTo,
        now = now,
        locale = Locale.forLanguageTag({{locale}}),
        onLoadOlder = {},
    ) { message, context ->
        MonarchMessageRow(
            author = MonarchMessageRowAuthor(message.author),
            time = message.time,
            now = now,
            grouped = context.grouped,
        ) { MonarchText(message.text) }
    }
}

}
